name: Typefully
briefs: Write exactly one English activation email from the Typefully team. Reader: A creator with a new Typefully account and rough notes for a social post. Ask them to do one thing: Create the first draft from their notes. Use a specific, documented first step and explain why it helps this reader. Keep the email under 150 words excluding subject, preview and signature. Avoid unsupported access, plan, timing and outcome claims. Use one CTA with an exact documented destination if available.

Write exactly one English activation email from the Typefully team. Reader: A Typefully user with a finished draft and an already connected social account. Ask them to do one thing: Schedule that draft for a specific date and time. Use a specific, documented first step and explain why it helps this reader. Keep the email under 150 words excluding subject, preview and signature. Avoid unsupported access, plan, timing and outcome claims. Use one CTA with an exact documented destination if available.
